schema_sql:
CREATE TABLE aliases(source_id TEXT, source_job_id TEXT, job_id TEXT NOT NULL, url TEXT NOT NULL,
          active INTEGER NOT NULL, last_seen TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(source_id, source_job_id))
CREATE TABLE jobs(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, dedup_key TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, data TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE meta(key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE observations(source_id TEXT, source_job_id TEXT, job_id TEXT NOT NULL,
          data TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(source_id,source_job_id))

CREATE TABLE reminders(job_id TEXT, deadline TEXT, band TEXT, emitted_at TEXT,
          PRIMARY KEY(job_id,deadline,band))

CREATE TABLE source_rejections(source_id TEXT, source_job_id TEXT, url TEXT NOT NULL,
          authority INTEGER NOT NULL, last_seen TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(source_id,source_job_id))
CREATE TABLE sources(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, data TEXT NOT NULL)
